layer_3_action.subject: Maiasaura
features: small solid bony crest lump between the eyes
layer_3_action.action: A friendly, stylized Maiasaura with smooth clay-like skin is pacing across a dense green fern-meadow, bowing its head down to search for low-growing horsetails. The camera is positioned at a low three-quarter angle to clearly catch the distinct small, solid bony crest lump situated right between its eyes. The background features open floodplain woodland flats under a soft clear sky. No text.
